name: ChangeLab external validity audit v1.1
purpose: Attempt to falsify semantic-check and scheduling value; not a new universal hallucination benchmark

label_origins.controlled: Automatically constructed transformations with declared expected statuses; not human-labeled model responses
label_origins.ragtruth: External human span annotations; implicit_true excluded from strict label; native ChangeLab semantic score unsupported/unscored
label_origins.release: Actual full retrieval source/version signature changes; not incorrect-answer labels

independence: Group all correlated answer variants, same numeric-masked temporal query, business source fields, and retriever results from one update. No pooled accuracy across different targets.
reproduction: Run fetch.py, run.py, incremental.py, promptfoo_compare.py; use pinned requirements and inspect protocol revisions
license: Project-authored code and indexes: MIT. RAGTruth license retained upstream. TimelyQABench lacks an explicit repository license; external corpus text is fetched on demand and not redistributed here. Real project documentation retains its upstream license.

live_lightrag.reason: No deployment/provider was configured; CPU retrieval and recorded answers do not satisfy this gate

workflow_success_meaning: Successful execution and integrity checks; does not imply the utility continuation gate passed
